test_cases.name: Requesting Quote Review and Update for Existing Quote
test_cases.description: The customer, Michael Reyes, is requesting to review and update an existing quote. He provides detailed context and background, setting up for a later ambiguous update request.

initial_turn.subject: Request to Review and Update My Existing Quote
initial_turn.body:
Dear Sales Team,

I hope this message finds you well. I am writing to request a review of the quote I recently received from your team. Before proceeding to finalize the order, I would like to discuss a few potential adjustments to some of the items listed, particularly regarding quantities and possibly the unit of measure for certain products.

To provide some background, our team is currently reassessing our inventory needs for the upcoming quarter, and as such, there may be some changes required to the original quote. I want to ensure that the final version accurately reflects our updated requirements.

Could you please confirm the process for making these adjustments? Once I have your guidance, I will send over the specific details for the items that need to be updated.

Best regards,
Michael Reyes
